rules.statement: A decree absolute for default that has been passed against a defendant by a District Court can operate as res judicata in a subsequent action between the same parties in respect of the same subject-matter.
rules.supporting_quote: "A decree absolute for default that has been passed against a defendant by a district court is one to which section 207 of the Civil Procedure Code applies and can, therefore, operate as res judicata in a subsequent action between the same parties in respect of the same subject-matter."
